script.problem: It has 37 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.

terra.problem: “Foreskin” may be unfamiliar to a 10-year-old. Explain that it is the skin covering the tip of the penis.
The wording suggests that no Gentiles were circumcised, but the sources say other peoples also practiced circumcision. “Rite” may also be unfamiliar; “practice” is plainer.
In Philippians 3:3, “the circumcision” refers to believers who worship by God’s Spirit. None of the meanings describes this use for a group of people.
